take: One continuous take of the whole passage, followed by the existing soundcheck. No numeric pause instructions and no spoken tags.
direction: A plain, conversational explainer in one continuous take. Open curious and close to the listener, let the numbers land flat and exact, and keep the limits dry rather than alarmed. Findings get a measured lift, never a triumphant one. The quietest and most settled delivery belongs to the closing answer. Breathe naturally at commas and full stops, and keep each clause whole.

lines.text: In a cardiothoracic suite at Houston Methodist Hospital, four cameras on the walls of each operating room watched each case.
lines.intent: Curious opening that places the room.
lines.energy: Open lightly curious, lifting a notch on the cameras.

audit.picture: The room lights and the name plate settles (s1-event-1, s1-event-2). The four wall cameras light in turn (s1-event-3).
audit.picture_check: Passes for the cameras. The room is one generic illustration, which is acceptable under the suite scope of c1. The name plate wording needs the director's decision (D6).
audit.pronunciation: Houston is HYOO stun in every Texas use, per TEXAS_PRONUNCIATION.md. Methodist and cardiothoracic are standard.
audit.breath: A natural breath after 'Hospital,' which completes the first clause and gives the first caption.
audit.source_note: c1 is scoped to the suite, not every operating room in the hospital. The line says each operating room in the suite, which is inside that scope.

lines.text: The system timestamped patient entry, draping and room turnover.
lines.energy: Settle a notch below the opening.

audit.picture: The clock ring draws (s2-event-1). The entry, draping and turnover stamps land on the ring during n2b (s2-event-2 to s2-event-4).
audit.picture_check: Mismatch, see D4. 'timestamped' in n2a is pictured as the ring drawing, and the first stamp arrives on 'patient entry' in n2b. The emphasis sits on that first stamp so the voice and the picture meet there.
audit.breath: Keep connected. Do not breathe between 'timestamped' and 'patient entry'. The storyboard caption split there is provisional and follows the measured silence.
audit.source_note: c13 supports 'timestamped' as automated real time documentation. c2 says no second level timing is shown, and the line makes no clock time claim.

lines.text: It also texted the surgeon when the patient was draped.
lines.intent: Consequence for the surgeon, matter of fact.
lines.energy: Small lift on the surgeon, then level.

audit.picture: The surgeon's phone lights (s3-event-1). The drape is laid (s3-event-2). The text alert reading patient draped slides onto the phone (s3-event-3).
audit.picture_check: Mismatch, see D3. 'texted the surgeon' in n3a is pictured as a lit phone. The alert text arrives inside n3b. A viewer with captions covered cannot see a text sent when the word 'texted' is spoken.
audit.breath: A natural breath after 'surgeon' is permitted, because 'It also texted the surgeon' is a complete clause. Keep 'when the patient was draped' with it.
audit.source_note: c3 says automated text notifications informed surgeons when patients were draped. The paper does not show the message text or what surgeons did next, and the line claims nothing more.

lines.text: A hospital study compared that suite with other Houston Methodist sites and found about 25 more surgeries a month.
lines.intent: Reveal the comparison and its estimate.
lines.energy: Clear lift into the number, still measured.

audit.picture: A study card lands (s4-event-1). The suite line and the dashed comparison line draw side by side (s4-event-2). The suite line climbs and the counter reaches about 25 (s4-event-3, s4-event-4).
audit.picture_check: Mismatch, see D5. 'with other Houston Methodist sites' in n4b has no visible label or site marks on the dashed line. 'compared that suite' in n4a is shown only as a card landing.
audit.pronunciation: Houston is HYOO stun, per TEXAS_PRONUNCIATION.md.
audit.breath: Breathe after 'sites', which completes the clause 'A hospital study compared that suite with other Houston Methodist sites'. Do not breathe after 'suite', because the storyboard caption split there would break the verb phrase.
audit.source_note: c4 is a weighted combination of 11 sites. c5 says approximately 25 cases per month. The line says surgeries, a near synonym of the paper's cases, and keeps 'about'. The approved wording is unchanged.

lines.text: That is a rise of 7 percent. The 95 percent confidence interval runs from 8.3 to 41.0 cases a month.
lines.intent: Qualify the estimate with its range.
lines.energy: Drop from the number to a steady, plainer line.

audit.picture: The 7 percent badge stamps (s5-event-1). The axis draws (s5-event-3). The whisker draws from 8.3 to 41.0 with its unit label (s5-event-4, s5-event-5).
audit.picture_check: Passes. The whisker ends match the spoken range.
audit.pronunciation: Read the numerals as spoken figures. Keep 'cases a month' attached to '41.0'.
audit.breath: Breathe after 'percent.'. Take no breath between 'interval' and 'runs', or between '41.0' and 'cases a month'. Those joins are the clause and unit boundaries that a caption split would otherwise break.
audit.source_note: c5 gives 7 percent as a relative increase over baseline and 8.3 to 41.0 as the 95 percent confidence interval. The line keeps the rise and the range together.

lines.text: A placebo test did not reach conventional significance.
lines.intent: Flat report of the failed placebo test.
lines.energy: Lower and flat, a clear step down.

audit.picture: Placebo units drop onto the desk (s6-event-1). The suite unit joins as the eleventh (s6-event-2). The crooked stamp lands (s6-event-3).
audit.picture_check: Passes. Eleven units, ten placebo and the suite, match the c6 scope note.
audit.breath: One phrase. No breath inside it.
audit.source_note: The approved line states the limit. c6 also says the result was directionally consistent with the main estimate. That qualifier is outside this line, so the director may decide on it (D8). The line is accurate as written.

lines.text: The authors call the rise associated with the rollout, rather than caused by it.
lines.intent: Say the first two words, the authors, slowly and crisply, with a clear first syllable and a clear closing s on authors. Then separate association from cause, as the authors state.
lines.energy: Sharpest clear turn, then back to level.

audit.picture: The associated card slides in (s7-event-1). The dashed link draws (s7-event-2). The solid 'caused' arrow draws and is struck through (s7-event-3).
audit.picture_check: Passes. The struck arrow lands in n7b, the same clause as 'rather than caused by it'.
audit.breath: A natural breath after 'rollout,' which is a complete clause boundary. Keep 'rather than caused by it' with the claim, with no breath between it and 'associated with the rollout'.
audit.source_note: c7 is the authors' own wording. The emphasis lands on the qualifier, so no listener hears causation.

lines.text: The rollout came bundled with other workflow changes, and the hospital holds a minority stake in the camera company.
lines.intent: List the confounds as dry limits.
lines.energy: Level and a touch drier than the line before.

audit.picture: The camera tag and review notes appear (s8-event-1). The bundle band snaps (s8-event-2). The company tag and ownership ring appear (s8-event-3). The minority slice lights, with no number (s8-event-4).
audit.picture_check: Passes. The slice carries no number, as the claim requires.
audit.breath: A natural breath after 'changes,', a complete clause boundary the storyboard caption already uses.
audit.source_note: c8 lists the bundle as turnover review, housekeeping, infection control, anesthesia and surgeon notification changes. c9 is the minority equity in Apella Technology, which the line calls the camera company and does not name.

lines.text: The paper leaves turnover time for future work.
lines.intent: Name the open question the paper leaves.
lines.energy: Quiet and level, below the line before.

audit.picture: The future work card lands (s9-event-1). The room clock draws with its turnover marker lit (s9-event-2). The card tags the marker (s9-event-3).
audit.picture_check: Passes. The tag lands at the end of the clause. This line must be its own line in vo_script.txt, see D1.
audit.breath: A natural breath at the full stop after 'work.' is permitted. It must not merge with the closing answer.
audit.source_note: c10 says future work should assess turnover time. The paper did not formally evaluate turnover.

lines.text: So the study does not show whether the rollout sped up room turnover.
lines.intent: Closing answer as a limit, settled, not a verdict.
lines.energy: Lowest and most settled, with no lift at the end.

audit.picture: The turnover marker pulses and the dashed blank box draws (s10-event-1, s10-event-2). The room light lowers while the four lamps stay lit (s10-event-3).
audit.picture_check: Passes, subject to D1. The closing answer must stay its own spoken line.
audit.breath: One phrase with no breath inside, so the answer is not split across captions early.
audit.source_note: c10 says turnover time was not formally evaluated. Story selection records that the hospital blog says turnover decreased, which is not a claim in claims.json. The paper does not test it, so the line makes no claim either way.
